    A very good cordless phone in comparison to other brands 👍
    This is my review regarding the cordless phone after using it for a few days - Great signal range - In order to get higher coverage, the base units need to be kept at a height like an office table or side table - Battery backup – Adequate and Sufficiently good battery backup. When not in use, you can keep the handset on base unit (this won't damage the battery) - Built - Light weight, well-built and compact cordless phone - Paging Option - Base unit has a paging button option to find the misplaced headset - Speaker Option - The headset has a speaker option with quite a high sound, volume can be adjusted - Backlight – The headset has a back light but not for the key pad - Ringtone – There are multiple options of ringtone that are loud enough and the volume can be further increased in the set up option. It depends on the ringtone option you choose - Easy to Use – The Menu and the Setting options are easy to use - Charging Indicator – The headset has a charging indicator letting you know that the headset is charging - No interference faced when using the phone-

      5 out of 5 stars
      A very good cordless phone in comparison to other brands 👍
      Reviewed in India on 8 January 2024
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This is my review regarding the cordless phone after using it for a few days

      - Great signal range - In order to get higher coverage, the base units need to be kept at a height like an office table or side table

      - Battery backup – Adequate and Sufficiently good battery backup. When not in use, you can keep the handset on base unit (this won't damage the battery)

      - Built - Light weight, well-built and compact cordless phone

      - Paging Option - Base unit has a paging button option to find the misplaced headset

      - Speaker Option - The headset has a speaker option with quite a high sound, volume can be adjusted

      - Backlight – The headset has a back light but not for the key pad

      - Ringtone – There are multiple options of ringtone that are loud enough and the volume can be further increased in the set up option. It depends on the ringtone option you choose

      - Easy to Use – The Menu and the Setting options are easy to use

      - Charging Indicator – The headset has a charging indicator letting you know that the headset is charging

      - No interference faced when using the phone-

    About this Item

    • Digital cordless phone. 50 name and number phonebook
    • Hands-free Speakerphone, Microphone mute and Caller ID / Call waiting*
    • 40 name and number Caller ID list Ringer melodies (user selectable). Intercom / Call transfer between handsets
    • Time, Date and Alarm facility 10 redial memory.
    • Expendable up to 5 handsets. Up to 12 hours talk time / Up to 250 hours standby time**

    Product description

    Motorola C401i cordless for locating anywhere within range. 50 Name and Number phonebook. Speakerphone for hands-free conversations. Caller ID shows you who’s calling and see details of the last 40 callers in a Calls list.* Redial up to 10 of the last numbers called. Register up to 5 handsets to a single base and register each handset with up to 4 different bases. Make internal calls and transfer external calls between handsets. Choose from 10 different ringer melodies for internal and external calls as well as numbers stored in the phonebook
